semiconductor_relevance: High — WPIC specializes in semiconductor plasma generation equipment and offers comprehensive services in semiconductor manufacturing processes.
summary: Wisdom Power International Corporation LTD (WPIC) focuses on providing sales and services for semiconductor plasma generation equipment, including advanced solutions for etching, CVD, and PVD processes. The company is committed to enhancing process yields through innovative technologies and offers complete plasma system solutions along with after-sales support.
capabilities: Sales and service of semiconductor plasma generation equipment
Advanced arc detection and control technology for etching and deposition processes
Refurbishment and repair services for plasma systems
Distribution of Comet’s vacuum capacitor and plasma power supply

regional_presence.Taiwan: WPIC operates as a distributor of Comet’s products and provides services in Taiwan.
regional_presence.Singapore: The company also has a presence in Singapore, offering similar services and products.
